metadata.coordinate_policy: Latitude and longitude are intentionally null in this first pass unless exact venue geocoding has been verified. No coordinates have been guessed.

festivals.atlas_summary: Wave-Gotik-Treffen is a curated RetroAltFest atlas record for goth, darkwave, industrial, post-punk travelers, located in Leipzig · Saxony · Germany. This entry keeps official sources, status notes, and mapping cautions close to the surface so visitors can evaluate the festival without relying on scraped or guessed data.
festivals.why_it_matters: Wave-Gotik-Treffen is one of the defining pilgrimage points for global goth and dark alternative culture: a city-scale gathering where venues, streets, museums, clubs, and sub-scenes all become part of the experience. For RetroAltFest, it anchors the atlas as a benchmark for festivals that are more than a lineup — they are temporary nocturnal cities.
